name: muscle-up
instructions:
1. Assume a hanging position from a pull bar with a false grip.
2. Pull yourself vertically and slightly behind the bar.
3. Once your momentum begins to slow and your chest is approaching the bar, transition from a pull up into a dip.
4. Finish the dip by pressing to extension and extending the elbows.
5. Reverse the movement by flipping the elbows and dropping back down into the pullup.
6. Slowly lower back to the starting position repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
